yacl3.config.slotplus:config.title: SlotPlus
yacl3.config.slotplus:config.enabled.des: Master switch for the bind gesture and the swap triggers. On by default.
yacl3.config.slotplus:config.hotbarShift: Shift-clicking a bound hotbar slot swaps it with its bound inventory slot instead of moving the item to the top of the inventory. Off by default.
yacl3.config.slotplus:config.keybindNote: The bind key can be rebound in Options > Controls > Key Binds.
slotplus.tutorial.title: SlotPlus
slotplus.tutorial.line1: Hold [%s] and click an inventory or armor slot to start a bind.
slotplus.tutorial.line2: Then click (or drag and release over) a hotbar slot to finish.
slotplus.tutorial.line3: Middle-click or shift-click a bound slot to swap it with your hotbar.
